context: Up to £10 · about an hour · just you · not much energy · going out

cards.title: People-watch and invent their backstories
cards.summary: Find a bench or a café window, pick strangers, and decide who they really are and where they’re going. Quietly.
cards.why: Free, takes no energy, and it gets funnier the more ridiculous the stories get.
cards.better: Give every stranger a name and a secret. With someone? First to laugh loses.

cards.title: Buy a harmonica
cards.summary: Learn one recognisable tune badly and enjoy the novelty.
cards.why: Nobody expects you to be good at harmonica. Freeing, really.
cards.better: Learn the theme tune to something daft and perform it for one lucky person.

cards.title: Go to a car boot sale
cards.summary: Go early, bring change, and look for the oddest thing on any table.
cards.why: Treasure hunting, people-watching and fresh air in one go.

nah.title: Chalk a hopscotch and play it
nah.summary: Draw a grid on the pavement or patio and play. If you remember the rules, great. If not, make some up.
nah.why: Being outside, moving, and slightly ridiculous. All three help.
nah.better: Leave it there for the next person to find.
